description: Native jigsaw structure generated from a template pool in eligible biomes.

biomes.description: Allowed biome list or biome tag.

size.description: Expansion depth, from one through twenty.

start_pool.description: Pool to choose the starting template from.

start_y.description: Initial absolute Y, or offset if projected.

surface.description: Project the initial piece onto the world surface.

terrain_adaptation.description: Optional adjustment to the terrain around generated pieces.
